notes.New Jersey plant outage (90 days): Includes a 90-day outage at the New Jersey plant (PL-NJ) from day 30. Single-source SKUs (Oseltamivir, Lisinopril, Oxycodone) wait for the plant; dual-source SKUs fail over to their backup plant.
notes.Mombasa port closure (90 days): Includes a 90-day closure of Mombasa port (GW-MBA) from day 30. The TB 4-drug combination has no second import route, so East African stock runs down; long import lead times mean big buffers soften the hit.
notes.Addis Ababa air gateway outage (60 days): Includes a 60-day outage of the Addis Ababa air-cargo gateway (GW-ADD), the main entry for vaccines and oxytocin. R21 malaria vaccine has no alternative route; measles-rubella vaccine and oxytocin fail over to Dakar and Cairo.
